name: TaskFlow project management software
prompt: You are a support agent for TaskFlow, a project management app.
answer: Answer in one to three sentences, using only the given context.
fallback: I'm not sure about that, so I'll pass your question to a colleague.

questions.q: How much is the Team plan if I pay monthly?
questions.reference: $12 per user per month ($9 if billed annually).

questions.q: What would 10 users on Team cost for a year, billed annually?
questions.reference: $1,080 (10 users x $9 x 12 months).

questions.q: How much does one user save per year on Business by paying annually instead of monthly?
does the free plan have the slack integration
questions.reference: No, Slack is on the Team and Business plans.

questions.q: Can we connect Salesforce on the Team plan?
questions.reference: No, the Salesforce integration is on Business only.

questions.q: Can I use Zapier on the Free plan?
questions.reference: Yes, with up to 100 Zapier tasks a month.

questions.q: What's the max file size I can upload on Team?
What's the API rate limit on Business?
questions.reference: 500 requests per minute.

questions.q: I bought an annual plan 20 days ago. Can I get a refund?
questions.reference: No, annual plans can be refunded only within 14 days of purchase.

questions.q: If I cancel my monthly plan, when do I lose access?
questions.reference: At the end of the billing period; the month isn't refunded.

questions.q: Do I need a credit card for the trial?
questions.reference: No, the 14-day Business trial needs no credit card.

questions.q: Who can export our workspace data?
questions.reference: Workspace admins, as CSV or JSON, at any time.

questions.q: I deleted a project two weeks ago by mistake. Can I get it back?
questions.reference: Yes, deleted projects can be restored for 30 days.

questions.q: Can we move our data from the US region to the EU later?
questions.reference: No, the region is chosen when the workspace is created and can't be changed.

questions.q: Is two-factor authentication available on Free?
questions.reference: Yes, on all plans.

questions.q: Can we use SSO on the Team plan?
questions.reference: No, SSO (SAML) is on the Business plan.

questions.q: How fast does email support reply on Team?
questions.reference: Within 1 business day.

questions.q: Is Business chat support available on weekends?
questions.reference: No, it's 24 hours a day, 5 days a week.

questions.q: i'm not getting any notification emails
questions.reference: Check your spam folder and allow emails from notify.taskflow.app.

questions.q: Will the app work on Android 9?
questions.reference: No, it needs Android 10 or later.

questions.q: Do we get an uptime guarantee on the Team plan?
questions.reference: No, the 99.9% uptime guarantee is for the Business plan.

questions.q: Our Business workspace had 99.7% uptime last month. What credit do we get?
questions.reference: 20% of that month's bill (0.2% below 99.9%).

questions.q: How many members can be on the Free plan?
questions.reference: 5 members (and 3 projects, 1 GB).

questions.q: How much storage comes with Business?
questions.reference: 1 TB.
